items.summary: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 lets a remote authenticated attacker execute arbitrary code, because a user-supplied value can influence code the product generates. Published 7 November 2026.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 lets a remote authenticated attacker perform arbitrary file writes via path traversal. Published 7 November 2026.

A flaw in Keycloak's client management lets an authenticated attacker with client-management permissions bypass security controls and upload a malicious JavaScript policy, leading to remote code execution. Affects Red Hat Build of Keycloak and Red Hat Single Sign-On 7; published 7 November 2026.
IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0 through 8.6.2.2 lets a remote attacker bypass security restrictions due to an improper Content Security Policy configuration. Published 8 November 2026.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 uses hard-coded credentials, allowing a remote attacker to gain full administrative control. Published 7 November 2026.
